lifecycle_rules.loop: Every master goal, bug report/fix, master-to-subagent assignment, and peer task follows Trigger -> Work -> Gate -> State -> Stop.
lifecycle_rules.sequence: Discover -> durable dispatch intent -> Hand off -> Verify -> Persist -> Schedule.
lifecycle_rules.role_default: Default identity is peer; master authority is user-authorized through explicit promotion or delegation by the current live master.
lifecycle_rules.wake: Only master has long-horizon wake; workers are not long-horizon wake targets and are not automatically woken from idle.
lifecycle_rules.worker_idle_fact: On each worker working -> idle transition, emit one idempotent worker-idle fact to the live master; master stops after three scheduling turns with an idle fact and no working change.
lifecycle_rules.sendmessage: Explicit collab sendmessage is immediate; idle, progress, delivery, bug, and worker-idle notices are auto-merged by the daemon in the 120-second batch window.
lifecycle_rules.bug_backlog: Bugs enter AppSDK or git-bug backlog with investigation evidence; P0 blocks the affected project.
lifecycle_rules.desktop: Desktop does not register goal subscribe.
lifecycle_rules.unknown_failure: Unknown, timeout, and failure are preserved explicitly; no ACK/fallback fake success.
lifecycle_rules.review_gates: AGY review is not used for Collab v1 lifecycle gates; ordinary review uses an independent review path, and a milestone may use Astra when required.
lifecycle_rules.legacy: Any 15-minute periodic worker liveness wording is deprecated and non-authoritative; current v1 contract uses the task-bound inspect obligation and master-only long-horizon wake.

gate_descriptions.independent-review: Ordinary Collab v1 review uses an independent review path; AGY review is not used.
gate_descriptions.milestone-review: A milestone review may use Astra when required; it is not an ordinary lifecycle gate.
gate_descriptions.loop-rules: Documented gate: each lifecycle is Trigger -> Work -> Gate -> State -> Stop and follows Discover -> durable dispatch intent -> Hand off -> Verify -> Persist -> Schedule.
gate_descriptions.bug-backlog: Documented gate: bugs are tracked in AppSDK/git-bug backlog and P0 blocks affected projects.
gate_descriptions.role-default: Documented gate: default identity is peer; master is explicit and user-approved.
gate_descriptions.worker-wake: Documented gate: workers are not long-horizon woken; working -> idle sends one idempotent fact; unknown does not wake; master stops after three scheduling turns with an idle fact and no working change.
